name: slack
title: Slack channel
tagline: Patchwell — an IT helpdesk for small teams, answered inside Slack: a live Slack-style view of your mate, grounded chat, an MCP server over the service catalogue and tickets, WebMCP helpdesk actions, and identified-customer ticket lookup.
slack_note: The real go-live hook lives in public/slack-config.json (the field the page actually reads at runtime). Once this tenant's own Slack app is connected via connect_channel kind:slack, set channelUrl/workspaceName there and redeploy — the 'Open in Slack' CTAs switch to the real workspace channel automatically.
